newsitem.title: CHINA: China says tourism earnings rise 15 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China says tourism earnings rise 15 percent in 1996.

text.p: China estimates record earnings of $10 billion from overseas tourists in 1996, a rise of almost 15 percent from the previous year, a senior tourism official said on Friday.

China's tourist industry also earned about 160 billion yuan ($19.2 billion) this year from domestic sightseers, the Xinhua news agency quoted Sun Gang, deputy director of the China National Tourism Administration, as saying.
Last year, more than 46.4 million foreign tourists visited China, spending $8.7 billion, he said. He did not give the number of tourists in 1996.
From 1991 to 1995, China played host to 203 million overseas tourists and earned a total of $27.5 billion from tourism.
